svg.text: Nut recess Ø14 x 1.5, hole Ø7.5
AUX counterbore Ø10 x 3, hole Ø6.4
Print front face down. Profile: PLA Parts 0.25. No supports.
Counterbores Ø6.0 x 1.5 (front) and x 2.25 (tray), membrane 0.25:
drill Ø3.4 from the back after the print.
Cut the pot and AUX membranes with a knife.
Spacer frames 70 x 70, 3 thick, 10 x 45° corners: 8 inserts M3 x 3.
Snap pockets: 3.0 deep, 45° lip, see BSM-09.
